title: SOS TX emission: no stack emits dispatch 0x16 (18.4.3 wire form)
description: b7z9.120 follow-up: with the dispatch 0x16 classification now landed in all three stacks (Rust lichen-core L2PayloadKind::Sos + wrap_sos_payload, Python L2PayloadKind.SOS + wrap_sos_payload, C LICHEN_L2_PAYLOAD_SOS), no sender actually EMITS an SOS frame with dispatch 0x16. spec 12-apps.md §18.4.3 (REQUIRED): sender MUST emit SOS with link-layer dispatch 0x16 carrying the §18.4.2 CBOR alert map, NOT as SCHC-compressed CoAP; relays classify solely by this byte for the 3/hour SOS budget. Consequence until wired: 18.4.3 rebroadcast-once and the SOS budget cannot work. Placement: SOS TX emission paths in C (sos_post / link TX), Python (node SOS send), Rust (lichen-node SOS TX), each wrapping the canonical SOS CBOR with the 0x16 dispatch.
